about: Text patches that adapt the canonical Cursor pstack (vendor/cursor-plugins/pstack) for Claude Code and Codex. Applied by `joyride install pstack` into .joyride/pstack/skills/<name>; the vendored clone is never edited. Replacements run in order on every .md file (and on the code files a patch names). Template variables: {{MODELS_NOTE}} (absolute path of the Joyride-managed models note), {{CLAUDE_AGENTS}} (Claude Code agents dir), {{CLAUDE_SKILLS}} (Claude Code skills dir).

skip.make-bot-ui: built on Cursor-only agent tools (update_state routines, SendToUser, api2.cursor.sh webhooks); nothing to adapt

preamble.text: > **Joyride adaptation for Claude Code and Codex.** A subagent means your harness's subagent tool. In Claude Code that is the Agent tool, with `subagent_type: general-purpose` unless this skill names an agent, and `model: opus`. Codex has no subagent tool, so run each role sequentially yourself. Per-role models live in `{{MODELS_NOTE}}`.

extra.poteto-mode: > **Joyride adaptation.** There are no cloud agents here: run workers as local subagents, or hand durable multi-step work to Firstmate. Pushes and PRs need the human's approval (Joyride's guard holds them); in Joyride projects, ship as a local branch merge.

poteto-agent.md.description: Routing target for /poteto-mode and any request for poteto's style. Spawn a fresh poteto-agent for each new task; resume one only in the strict cases poteto-mode's Subagents section names. Reads the poteto-mode skill's SKILL.md in full before any work.

comment-sicko.md.description: A deranged comment-hater that savors deletion and condemns workaround code. Spawned by the no-comments skill with a scope (files or a diff).
comment-sicko.md.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, MultiEdit, Skill
